statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-4610 is a Windows-only uncontrolled-search-path local privilege escalation in docker/cli plugins; this is a Linux image so the code path does not exist. It is also already fixed: the advisory's fix is v29.2.0+incompatible and trivy ships docker/cli v29.5.2+incompatible (grype mis-ranks the +incompatible pseudo-version and flags it anyway).
